title: Après Sea | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Après Sea is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: After your sun-soaked day at the beach, retreat to “Après Sea” – your family’s perfect getaway along 30A.This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 5.5-bath home is tucked inside the peaceful Creek Park at Magnolia in Seacrest Beach, where families come to relax, reconnect, and create lasting memories.Cruise around town in style with the included 6-seater golf cart – your easy, breezy ride to shops, dining, and the sugar-white sand. Après Sea sits just 0.5 miles from its private, deeded beach access and only 60 steps from the sparkling community pool, giving you the best of both worlds.Inside, you’ll find designer details and plenty of space for up to 16 guests. The open-concept living area features a cozy oversized sectional (perfect for movie nights or rainy-day hangouts), and the dining area comfortably seats your whole group. Slide open the wall of glass doors and let the Florida sunshine pour in, or gather on the screened-in porch for relaxed evenings of conversation.The chef’s kitchen is a dream for entertaining, with open shelving, modern appliances, and both drip and Keurig coffee options to fuel your mornings. Laundry facilities and an outdoor shower make beach days easy and carefree.Sleeping Arrangements – Sleeps 16 • 1st Floor Built-In Bunks: Fun hideaway for kids, near the half bath • Bedroom 1 (King): Ensuite with dual sinks + large shower • Bedroom 2 (King + Desk): Ensuite with dual sinks + large shower • Bedroom 3 (Queen): Ensuite with shower • Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): 2 Twin-over-Queen bunks + 2 twin trundles, ensuite with shower/tub comboWhy Guests Love Après Sea:? Private beach access + community pool just steps away? 6-seater golf cart included? Designer interiors + spacious open floor plan? Screened-in porch for outdoor living year-round? Sleeps 16 – perfect for large families or groupsThe LocationSeacrest Beach is one of 30A’s most family-friendly spots, nestled between Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Watersound. Après Sea keeps you close to all the action – boutique shopping, top-rated restaurants, and lively family entertainment at The Big Chill.Exclusive Perks with Your StayYour booking includes Xplorie’s top activities (over $800 value each night!) – one ticket per day, per activity. Tee off at championship golf courses, zipline at Baytowne, cruise with dolphins, or cool off at Big Kahuna’s Water Park. Adventure awaits!Good to Know • Parking for 3 cars • Sorry, no pets? Après Sea isn’t just a place to stay – it’s where unforgettable beach memories are made.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
